dataset_name: Door - Hörmann Legnica - side door NT500
Use advice for data set: This data set contains the results for modules A1-A3 as well as modules A4, A5, B2, B3, B5, B6, B7, C1, C2, C3, C4 and D in accordance with EN 15804 + A2. The modeling of the B-modules was based on 1 year. A comparison with other products is only permissible with a comparable application in the building. In principle, a comparison or evaluation of EPD data is only possible if all data sets to be compared were created in accordance with EN 15804 + A2 and the building context or the product-specific performance characteristics are taken into account. | |
Technical purpose of product or process: Side door (NT 500) for N 500 up-and-over garage door (see EPD-SGT-0.11.1), steel, single-leaf. Door elements single-leaf, appearance as up-and-over garage doors with steel and aluminium infill. Face width 60 mm, frame made of galvanised square tubing (60 × 60 mm), primer coating in door leaf colour. Door leaf fillings made of steel/aluminium or customer-supplied filling possible. Door filling made of steel. The galvanised frame profiles are primed in traffic white (based on RAL 9016) as standard. Version with high-quality powder coating (high-quality primer) on both sides, inside and outside: traffic white, based on RAL 9016. Colour, preferred colours based on RAL colour chart. Fittings and lock: Side door as standard with handle/handle, PZ version, black plastic, lock without profile cylinder (required profile cylinder length 40.5 / 40.5 mm, for motif 405 plus panel thickness), 3D aluminium hinges. The clear passage width is reduced at opening angles of less than 180°. | |
General comment on data set: This data set contains the results for modules A1-A3 and modules A4, A5, B2, B3, B5, B6, B7, C1, C2, C3, C4, D. The production of packaging was taken into account within modules A1-A3 | |
Technology description including backgro: The life cycle assessment results cover the life cycle stages from the manufacture of primary products to the extraction of raw materials and processing of secondary materials used as input (e.g. recycling processes), their transportation to the plant and the production itself, including the provision of all auxiliary and operating materials, energy, as well as the complete waste treatment or landfilling of residual waste during the production stage. Modules A1, A2 and A3 are shown here as an aggregated module A1-A3. If further modules were calculated for this data set, these can be found separately and can be combined for a consideration of the entire life cycle.
